summary: Portland, Oregon, designer, freelance coder, experience in web development and software engineering, interest in Bitcoin and online gaming, critical of corporate culture and social media, values personal freedom and privacy, has lived in various countries including Argentina, Vietnam, and France, strong opinions on political and social issues, advocates for individual agency and critical thinking, has a background in art and design, experienced in creating interactive applications, has a history of working with startups and tech companies, values community and personal connections over digital interactions.
